== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Hunger [[aura]], also known as the [[aura]] of [[blood]] and [[hunger]], is an unnatural force that functions through consumption. Rather than being a natural phenomenon, it is linked to the presence of [[Monarchs]]; without their influence, the [[Dreadgods]] would likely weaken and perish. This [[aura]] acts as a corrupting agent that can weaken or consume all other forms of [[aura]], including natural spirits, [[sacred beasts]], and humans. It is characterized by a ravenous quality that can manifest as an intense, overwhelming sensation in the mind or as a physical force that devours both energy and material substances. The [[aura]] is deeply connected to the [[Dreadgods]], serving as a core aspect of their power. For example, the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] utilizes a blend of [[blood]] and [[hunger aspects]], while other [[Dreadgods]] use [[hunger]]-based techniques to siphon energy. This power can manifest through various entities, such as [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]]—creatures that rise from [[blood]] to feed on [[madra]]—or through specialized [[hunger techniques]] and [[constructs]]. When active, the [[aura]] can drive individuals toward intense greed, ambition, or bloodlust, and it possesses a parasitic quality that nibbles away at the power of those nearby. In its most potent forms, it can appear as a swirling, colorless or white-and-gray energy capable of corrupting the very landscape.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Originating as a wave of power from [[Sacred Valley]], the [[hunger]] [[aura]] is an all-consuming force that feels like an endless, gnawing greed. This corruption of the natural order is a manifestation of selfish desire and ambition created by the presence of [[Monarchs]], capable of eroding the spirits of even a [[Monarch]]. Within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], the thick [[aura]] suppresses spatial artifacts, devours mental energy, and makes people weak while grinding away their very spirits. The phenomenon can take the form of a disgusting white shape resembling a person leeched of color, and it actively eats away at [[natural treasures]]. This force corrupts humans, [[sacred beasts]], natural spirits, and [[Remnants]] alike, as seen in the erosion of [[Reigan Shen]]'s body. Ultimately, the [[aura]] howls amidst flickering [[Script|script-lights]] and threatens to exceed containment if [[Subject One]] is removed.}}
